subject_line: Your First Drink on Carnivore Will Surprise You
opening: Happy Monday, friend. This week we've got something for everyone: a community story that gave us chills, a metabolic truth most carnivores learn the hard way, and one protocol worth printing out. Grab your coffee and let's get into it.

hero.title: Carnivore and Alcohol: What Happens When You Drink
hero.teaser: You had two drinks. You felt like you had six. Then the next morning hit you like a freight train, and you had no idea why. It's not in your head. There's a real metabolic reason your body handles alcohol completely differently on carnivore, and once you understand it, you can actually plan around it. Sarah breaks down exactly what's happening inside your body, and what to do before, during, and after if you're going to drink.
hero.cta: Read before your next social event

supporting.title: Meatstock 2026: What 1,600 Carnivores in One Room Looks Like
supporting.teaser: Chloe walked the floor at Meatstock 2026 and came back with one observation that reframes everything people say about carnivore being a 'fringe diet.'

supporting.title: Carnivore Recomp: Losing Fat and Building Muscle at the Same Time
supporting.teaser: Marcus wrote down the exact protein targets and 12-week training structure he'd hand someone who insists you can't do both at once on carnivore.

supporting.title: What Beef Tallow Actually Does (And Why It's Trending)
supporting.teaser: Sarah found the science behind why your grandmother's cooking fat is suddenly back, and one of the reasons might genuinely change how you think about fat.

try_this_week: Swap your cooking oil for beef tallow this week, just once. Pick one meal, use tallow instead of whatever's in your pan right now, and pay attention to how you feel a few hours later. Community members report noticing a difference faster than they expected.
looking_ahead: Next week we're getting into something Marcus has been testing quietly for months, and the results on recovery time are not what anyone predicted. You'll want to open that one.
